privacy.title: Your Privacy Matters
privacy.intro: VivahSambandh respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.body: We collect the details you share while creating and managing your profile — name, contact information, photographs, family and education background, partner preferences and verification documents. We also record basic usage information that helps us keep the platform safe and reliable.
Your information is used to operate your account, suggest suitable matches, verify profiles, prevent fraud and communicate important updates. We never sell your personal information to third parties.

Profile details you mark as visible are shown to other verified members as per your privacy settings. Contact details are shared only when you choose to connect. Verification documents are used internally and never displayed publicly.
We use bank-grade encryption, strict access controls and regular monitoring to protect your data. No method is completely risk-free, so we encourage you to use a strong password and never share OTPs.
You may review, correct or delete your profile information at any time from your account, or write to us at support@vivahsambandh.com and our team will assist you within a reasonable time.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By creating an account or using VivahSambandh, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.body: You must be legally eligible for marriage as per Indian law (21 years or above for grooms, 18 years or above for brides) to register. Accounts may be created by the individual or by their family members on their behalf.

You agree to provide true, accurate and complete information. Profiles pass manual screening and optional ID verification before going live. We may suspend accounts with false, misleading or incomplete information.
Use the platform only for genuine matrimonial purposes. Harassment, abusive language, solicitation, spam, fake profiles or any unlawful activity will lead to immediate suspension without refund.

Basic profile creation and browsing are free. Paid plans unlock premium features as described on the Membership page. All payments are processed through secure gateways; plan benefits begin once payment is confirmed.

VivahSambandh is a matchmaking platform that facilitates introductions between families. We verify profiles with care, but the final decision to proceed with any alliance rests entirely with you and your family.

guidelines.title: A Respectful Community
guidelines.intro: These guidelines keep VivahSambandh safe, genuine and welcoming for every Agarwal family.

sections.body: Share real photographs, correct personal details and honest expectations. Profiles found to be fake or misleading are removed.
Be polite in every conversation. Abusive, offensive or threatening language towards any member or family is strictly prohibited.
Do not share another member's personal details, photographs or conversations outside the platform without their consent.
Never ask for money, gifts or financial favours. Do not promote businesses, schemes or any unrelated services on the platform.
If someone violates these guidelines, report the profile immediately through the Contact page. Meet new connections in safe, public settings and inform your family.

help.title: How Can We Help?
help.intro: Answers to common questions and the fastest ways to reach our support team.

sections.body: Click Create Profile, fill in your details and preferences, upload photographs and verify your phone number. Your profile goes live after a quick review by our team.
Use the Search section on the home page to browse by city, gotra, profession and education. Save your preferences to receive curated matches.
Compare plans on the Membership page. Payments are accepted through UPI, Net Banking and Credit/Debit cards with bank-grade encryption. Premium benefits activate as soon as payment is confirmed.
Look for verified badges on profiles. Never share OTPs or send money to anyone you meet online. Report suspicious profiles through the Contact page.
Still stuck? Reach us through the Contact page, call us Mon – Sat (10 AM – 6 PM), or email support@vivahsambandh.com — we reply within 24 hours.
